title: Chicken and Veggie Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful roast dish made with chicken and vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The lean cut of chicken is slow-cooked with roasted vegetables to create a satisfying and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: 1.5 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Peel and chop the carrots and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Mince the garlic and chop the onion.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the skillet and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the chicken and roasted vegetables hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
